task.contract:
Native functools.lru_cache diagnostic. A fresh query is exactly
{"capacity": integer, "events": [event, ...]}, with capacity 1..4 and at most
32 events. An event is exactly {"op":"call", "key":integer} with key 0..31,
or {"op":"reset"}. Booleans are not integers. A fresh capacity-sized cache
wraps a function returning its integer argument. Calls and resets operate in
list order. Reset calls cache_clear, clearing contents and hit/miss counters.
Return {"hits":integer,"misses":integer,"size":integer} from cache_info after
the events. Each query has an independent fresh cache. The source has no hidden
capacity or external data. Implement investigate(context, acquire), returning
that JSON object. No initial program is supplied. An allowed native probe uses
exactly the same query schema.

prompt.instruction: Implement the native behavior in ordinary restricted Python from this public contract and measured examples. You may use arbitrary helpers and state within a query. Return the simplest correct whole program. This is your first proposal; no source oracle or hidden evaluator is available.

system:
Return one JSON object with source, scope and change strings.
source is the COMPLETE executable Python program defining investigate(context, acquire).
Return exactly the JSON value requested in the task contract. Each query starts
fresh. context contains the task input only. There are no external tables.
Use the measured development examples to infer the source-specific behaviour.
Do not hardcode the example outputs; later queries have new values/combinations.
Only function definitions at module level. No imports, annotations, decorators,
default arguments, private names, exceptions, I/O or global state.
The single local name _ is allowed; other leading-underscore names are not.
Use x*x and x*x*x rather than exponentiation (**); do not use function defaults.
For and while loops, comprehensions, lambda, nonlocal closure variables,
arithmetic except power, and bit shifts are permitted. No classes,
try/except, yield or recursion tricks.
All execution remains bounded by the worker CPU, memory and wall-time limits.
Builtins: abs all any bool chr dict enumerate float int isinstance len list max min
range repr reversed round set sorted str sum tuple zip.
Methods: get items keys values append extend sort lower upper strip split join
setdefault add discard copy count index pop remove clear update.
Limit 60000 UTF8 bytes. Use scope/change for concise technical claims, not a
chain-of-thought transcript. No source evaluator or hidden configuration is available.
